instruction: Configure LibreOffice Impress to always start presentations in full-screen mode by default.

metadata.explanation: Task requires modifying presentation start settings (Slide Show > Slide Show Settings > Always on top / Full screen). Evaluator verifies AlwaysWithFullScreen is set to true in the configuration file.
metadata.verification_method: Configuration file structure verified by reading existing check_presenter_console_disable function and LibreOffice registry XML schema

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts the LibreOffice configuration file which persists the full-screen presentation setting
Metric logic correctly searches for the AlwaysWithFullScreen setting at the correct xpath (/org.openoffice.Office.Impress/Misc/Start)
Expected value 'true' is semantically correct for enabling full-screen mode by default
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (always start in full-screen) and evaluator checks exactly that setting
Data flow is sound: VM file getter → XML parsing → xpath/setting name lookup → value comparison
Implementation is robust with proper XML namespace handling, case-insensitive comparison, error handling, and logging
No postconfig needed as configuration file persists after UI operations
